literal_meaning: মাথায় হাত রাখা (to place hand on the head)
figurative_meaning_en: to be stunned or astonished in surprise
similar_in_english: to throw one's hands up in disbelief
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবরটা শুনে সে মাথায় হাত দিয়ে চুপ করে গেল।
এত বড় ভুল দেখে সকলে মাথায় হাত দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon hearing the news, he put his hand on his head and fell silent.
Everyone put their hands on their heads seeing such a huge mistake.
note: Often used to express overwhelming surprise or helplessness in Bengali culture
